# SIDRAH LABS

> Sidrah Labs (سِدْرَة لابس) engineers AI-ready lakehouses today, while forging formal verification infrastructure to make AI-paced engineering safe tomorrow.

Build data systems you can trust—and change at AI speed.

## What we do

95% of enterprise AI pilots stall in production because stochastic models are plugged into fragmented legacy ERPs and un-governed data landfills. Meanwhile, AI-generated pipelines move faster than human review can catch silent bugs. We re-architect hostile legacy data into AI-ready Databricks lakehouses today—while forging the formal verification infrastructure required to safely run AI-paced engineering tomorrow.


## Fixed-scope deployments

- **Legacy ERP & unstructured data to AI-ready Lakehouse** (A / AI-READINESS) — 14–21 days sprint target.
  Transition hostile SQL/Oracle/ERP silos and complex PDF streams into a governed Databricks Medallion architecture—wired directly to a concrete last-mile activation (a governed Genie/BI space, MCP context endpoint, or automated financial workflow).

  Focus: Legacy ERP extraction · Unstructured-to-Delta · Last-mile AI activation
- **Fivetran off-ramp & full-recompute refactoring** (B / UNSAAS) — 14 days sprint target.
  Eliminate runaway MAR billing spikes, rigid SaaS data lock-in, and silent full-table recomputes draining Serverless DBUs. We replace managed connectors with owned, incremental Python (dlt / PySpark) pipelines inside your VPC with mathematical source parity.

  Focus: UnSaaS ingestion · Row-hash parity · DBU & MAR cost reduction
- **Pre-execution contract gates & Golden-SQL evals** (C / HARDENING) — 10–14 days sprint target.
  When engineers and AI coding agents ship pipeline mutations at machine speed, syntax checks pass while join fan-outs and schema drift silently corrupt Gold tables. We install deterministic pre-execution gates and golden regression suites.

  Focus: Schema contracts · AST query checks · Golden-SQL evaluation

TIMELINES ARE SPRINT TARGETS; EXACT SCOPE AND PARITY GUARANTEES ARE LOCKED AFTER TECHNICAL DISCOVERY.

## How we deliver

We don't start from a blank repository or bill hours to reinvent standard plumbing. Each sprint deploys our proprietary internal software accelerators directly into your cloud VPC—compounding our delivery speed and your pipeline reliability.

- **Metadata-driven ingestion & UnSaaS kit**: Battle-tested PySpark and Python dlt frameworks for hostile ERP snapshot/merge diffing, high-concurrency API extraction, and zero-row-loss CDC reconciliation.
- **Deterministic DataFrame rules & parity engine**: Modular business-logic harnesses and automated row-hash parity checkers that prove migrated tables mathematically match legacy financial ground truth.
- **Pre-execution schema & AST logic gates**: Static query analysis, explicit contracts, and golden-dataset evaluation tools that intercept destructive SQL mutations and metric drift before execution.

## Production experience

- **Zero-downtime ERP Lakehouse & metadata ingestion**: Architected and operated an end-to-end Databricks Medallion lakehouse across complex ERP schemas. Engineered a config-driven PySpark snapshot/merge framework (onboarding new tables via config inserts) and automated multi-environment promotion—running in production for 2+ years. (2+ YEARS PRODUCTION)
- **High-concurrency unstructured & HealthAI extraction**: Engineered fault-tolerant extraction infrastructure for a Silicon Valley medical AI team—combining 100+ asynchronous spiders with layout-aware PDF/vision models to turn messy documents into schema-validated analytical tables. (100+ EXTRACTORS / VISION)
- **Symbolic execution & neuro-symbolic verification**: Founded by a Databricks Certified Data Engineer Pro with applied formal-methods research extending JavaPathFinder (JPF) and NeuroSPF symbolic execution harnesses—bridging classical constraint solving with neural/LLM representations. (JPF / NEURO-SYMBOLIC R&D)

## Applied R&D

As automated tools generate software and pipeline logic 240% faster, the enterprise bottleneck shifts from code creation to code trust. Without machine-checked verification, AI-paced engineering carries a poison pill: catastrophic, silent bugs in production.


To capture the real economic velocity of AI, verification must run as fast as generation. Sidrah Labs is developing reusable formal verification infrastructure and neuro-symbolic logic firewalls. By combining relational-algebra/AST compilers with SMT solvers (Z3) and incremental diff engines, we aim to mathematically prove that AI-generated code patches, SQL queries, and agent tool-calls preserve strict business invariants before they ever execute.


THE COMPOUNDING FLYWHEEL: Every enterprise migration and pipeline hardening sprint we execute exposes real-world failure modes that harden our internal verification harnesses—funding our independence today while forging the standalone verification infrastructure of tomorrow.
